description: This file defines the CartRepository class for managing shopping cart state and operations in an Android Kotlin app. It handles cart items, coupons, backend synchronization, and state management using Kotlin coroutines and flows.

classes.name: CartRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing cart items, coupons, synchronization with backend API, and state flows for UI consumption.

methods.name: setActiveEmail
methods.description: Sets or clears the current cart user by email, triggers cart migration and backend fetch.

methods.name: ensureCartLoaded
methods.description: Ensures the cart is loaded from backend at least once for the current user.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item with specified quantity to the cart, updates local state, and attempts backend sync.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a cart item, removes it if quantity is zero, with backend synchronization.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart, updates local state, and syncs with backend.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart both locally and on the backend.

methods.name: addSavedCoupon
methods.description: Adds a coupon code to local saved coupons list.

methods.name: removeSavedCoupon
methods.description: Removes a coupon code from local saved coupons list.

methods.name: clearSavedCoupons
methods.description: Clears all locally saved coupons.

methods.name: isCouponSaved
methods.description: Checks if a coupon code is saved locally.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Attempts to apply a coupon code, performs local validation, backend validation, and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes the currently applied coupon, attempts backend removal.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Returns a summary of cart totals, including item count and subtotal.

methods.name: discountedTotals
methods.description: Returns current cart totals including discounts.

methods.name: groupedByCategory
methods.description: Groups cart items by their category.

methods.name: refreshFromBackend
methods.description: Fetches cart data from backend and reconciles local state.

methods.name: migrateLocalCacheToBackendIfNeeded
methods.description: Migrates local cart items to backend, merging quantities.

methods.name: reconcileFromCartDto
methods.description: Updates local state from cart DTO received from backend.

methods.name: setAndPersist
methods.description: Updates local items list and saves to persist storage.

methods.name: recomputeTotalsLockedUnsafe
methods.description: Recomputes totals based on current state (assumes lock is held).

methods.name: recomputeTotalsLocked
methods.description: Recomputes totals based on current state (calls unsafe version).

methods.name: setCouponLocked
methods.description: Sets or clears the current coupon, updating state and persisting.

methods.name: validateCouponAgainstLocalConstraints
methods.description: Validates a coupon against local rules (e.g., expire, min subtotal).

methods.name: validateCouponWithBackendBestEffort
methods.description: Asynchronously validates a coupon via backend API, updates state based on result.

methods.name: buildCouponLineItemsLockedUnsafe
methods.description: Builds line items for coupon validation based on current cart items.

methods.name: normalizeCouponCode
methods.description: Normalizes raw coupon code string for processing.

methods.name: defaultLocalCouponForCode
methods.description: Creates a default local coupon placeholder for validation before backend validation.

methods.name: computeTotals
methods.description: Calculates subtotal, discount, and total for current cart and optional coupon.

methods.name: mergeSuggestions
methods.description: Merges saved coupons and optional server suggestions into a list.

methods.name: emitError
methods.description: Emits an error event into the flow for UI to handle.
